title: Yagyu Shinkage Ryu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Yagyu Shinkage Ryu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Yagyu Shinkage Ryu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 175 and is learned automatically at that level. Measured, precise counter-cutting and tight blade control. Wield one sword to use it.

At 100% mastery: +16 accuracy and +16% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 4 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
